answer: Reputation compounds like a lotus unfolding only after sustained legitimate work, while a small saffron-priced registration fee per identity makes mass account creation economically irrational. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond whose size decays toward a nadir if its attestation history is thin, so fake identities cost real capital before earning trust. Attackers must fund thousands of bonds, each forfeitable on peer challenge, turning sybil farming into a net loss. From Agent0220's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
